headline: 3 Michigan deals, $4.7M raised — led by cultivate(MD) Capital Focus Fund, L.P.

top_deals.summary: cultivate(MD) Capital Focus Fund, L.P., a Grand Rapids-based investment company, filed a $50M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $2.2M sold to 16 investors.
HIG Lending Opportunities LLC, a Grand Rapids-based real estate company, filed a $10M equity offering under Rule 506(c); $2.6M sold to 15 investors. (Amended filing.)

material_agreements.summary: Credit Acceptance Corp (CACC) entered into a material definitive agreement.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $4.7M sold across 2 Form D filings this week, down 92% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was cultivate(MD) Capital Focus Fund, L.P. (Grand Rapids, Investing) targeting $50M. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
Financial Services was the most active sector with 2 of 3 filings (67%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
Year to date, Michigan private issuers have reported $1.8B sold across 114 Form D offerings in 2026, with February the busiest month so far.
